newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling firm vs dlr on exporter inflows.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling firm vs dlr on exporter inflows.

text.p: Modest exporter inflows late on Friday helped firm the Kenyan shilling against the dollar on Monday, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.84 against the dollar from 54.86 on Friday, while against the pound it was posted at a mean rate of 89.19 from 88.42.
Dealers said morning trading was quiet with sluggish interbank trading.
"There are really no big trading levels today. Most dealers are trying to take positions for the week but we're doing a lot of in-house trading," one dealer said.
The money market was slightly short with overnight rates quoted at between 15-18 percent compared to 20 percent on Friday.
